title: Beta Recipe Tweaks
body:
# Recipe Tweaks Mod
RecipeTweaks adds a bunch of new Recipes and modifies some old ones.

Images ofall the Recipes are in the gallery.

## Configuration

All Recipes can be Enabled and Disabled in the config file.

If on multiplayer make sure the multiplayer and singleplayer configs are the same otherwise recipes enabled on the server but disabled on the client will work but the output will be invisible until you click it.


## List of Recipes:

- True = Enabled by Default
- False = Disabled by Default

<details>
<summary>Tweaks</summary>
  
- Fix Stair Recipes: Give 8 stairs instead of 4 (True)  
- Mini Stair Recipes: 3 Material in an L shape give 4 stairs (True)
- Fix Slab Recipes: Give 6 Slabs Instead of 3 (True
- Dye Any Wool Any Colour: Place any 1 wool of any color and 1 dye into a crafting table to dye it (True)
- Dye Any Wool Any Colour Easy: 8 Wool and 1 Dye to Dye 8 Wool at a time (False)
- More Powered Rails: 16 Powered rails instead of 8 (False)
- Craftable Flint: 3 Gravel for 1 Flint (true)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Shapeless</summary>

- Shapeless Mushroom Stew (True)
- Shapeless Chest And Powered Minecarts (True)
- Shapeless Sticky Piston (True)
- Shapeless Cake Recipe (True)
- Shapeless Shears Recipe (False)
- Shapeless Jack o Lantern (True)
- Shapeless Bread Recipe (True)
- Shapeless Cookie Recipe (True)
- Shapeless Paper Recipe (True)
- Shapeless Book Recipe (True)
- Shapeless Arrow Recipe: Also enables Shapeless Indev Arrow recipe (False)


</details>


<details>
<summary>Alternate</summary>
  
- Chest from Logs (True)
- 1 Stone for Button (True)
- Alpha Snow Recipe (False)
  

</details>


<details>
<summary>Uncraftable</summary>

- Craftable Mossy Cobblestone (True)
- Craftable Mossy Cobblestone Easy (False)
- Craftable String (True)
- Craftable Grass (False)
- Craftable Gold, Diamond, Iron, And Coal Ores (False)
- Craftable Lapis And Redstone Ore (False)
- Craftable Ice (True)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Backport</summary>

- Modern Fence Recipe (True)
- Modern Ladder Recipe (True)
- Modern Golden Apple Recipe (False)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Smelting</summary>

- Extra Smeltable Ores (False)
- Brick Block From Clay Block (False)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Indev</summary>

- Leather Armor from Wool (False)
- Painting From Planks Instead of Sticks (False)
- Arrows From Iron (False

</details>


<details>
<summary>Cheaty</summary>
- Craftable Fire (False)


</details>


## Installation

### Client
1. Install Modloader & Modloader MP
2. Place Client mod file in mods folder

### Server
1. Install Modloader MP
2. Place mod Server mod file in servers mods folder
